decision_conditions: The development, including long term management responsibilities and maintenance schedules shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Unit Management Plan Revision V1 dated October 2020 received 18th October 2023.
Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity.

The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those specified within the approved plans and/or application form, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
The intensity of the illuminance of the advertisement shall be no greater than 600Cdm2 during hours of darkness.
Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisements, shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the local planning authority.
Where an advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the local planning authority.
Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall
be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and reports as
per the earlier (original submission: PL/0141/23) and documents submitted below:&nbsp;</p><ul><li>Cover Letter received 18-10-2023.</li><li>Site Location Plan entitled A02342 received
18-10-2023;</li><li>Noise Level Report dated August 2020 received
18-10-2023;</li><li>Unit Management Plan Revision V1 dated October
2020 received 18-10-2023;</li><li>Hub Unit Details and Unit Elevations received
18-10-2023;</li><li>Communication Hub Proposal received
18-10-2023;</li><li>Planning and Design Statement received
18-10-2023;</li></ul>
description: Removal of condition 2 (period of consent) attached to planning permission PL/0141/23 dated 28/03/2024 for display of an illuminated advertisement affixed to a freestanding communication hub
